extracted.intended_audience: students of journalism, media and communication; readers seeking a broader understanding of contemporary journalism
extracted.subtask_description: An introductory textbook overviewing the field of Journalism Studies, its history, education and training of journalists, research methods, societal impact, global perspectives, and technological futures. Intended as a primer for students and those wanting a broad grounding in contemporary journalism.

rubrics_metrics.name: Introductory overview of Journalism Studies
rubrics_metrics.description: Provides an introductory overview of the emerging field of Journalism Studies, discussing key issues and contemporary debates.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Drawing on Conboy’s extensive experience in the field, the changing nature of journalism and its future directions are addressed.
